scripts.postinstall: pnpm --dir api install && pnpm --dir ui install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui "pnpm --dir api run start:dev" "pnpm --dir ui run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir api run build && pnpm --dir ui run build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir api test && pnpm --dir ui test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir api run typecheck && pnpm --dir ui run typecheck
